title: Build authentication and first-run onboarding UI
summary: Implemented accessible authentication and first-run onboarding UI with configured-provider availability, privacy-preserving actionable OAuth errors, local account profile editing, explicit no-organization/invited/returning state handling, authenticated navigation, and system coverage for the four required user journeys.

decisions: Kept onboarding state behind Tenancy::Public and identity state behind Identity::Public
Used controller-injectable resolvers to test no-organization invited and returning paths before organization and invitation schemas exist
Converted internal OAuth failures into allowlisted public presentations without reflecting provider or exception detail
Initial architecture check exposed a direct Tenancy-to-Identity model dependency; replaced it with the documented public boundary and reran the suite
risks: Real database-backed organization and invitation resolution is intentionally deferred to prompts 024 and 028; until then authenticated users receive the honest no-organization onboarding state
Organization creation remains unavailable until prompt 025 supplies that workflow
next_steps: Prompt 023 implements security settings and security event visibility
Prompt 024 must replace the tenancy fallback with membership-backed returning-state resolution
Prompt 028 must connect invitation-backed first-run resolution
